claims.text: The resort is in the Dhaalu Atoll in the Maldives.

findings.quote: At Baglioni Maldives, in the Dhaalu Atoll, every day unfolds in a dreamlike setting.

claims.text: The resort operates on an all-inclusive basis.

findings.quote: All Inclusive Barefoot Luxury at Baglioni Maldives

claims.text: The Beach Villa is set directly on the beach, surrounded by tropical vegetation, a few steps from the sea.

findings.quote: Set directly on the beach, surrounded by tropical vegetation and just a few steps from the sea, the Beach Villa is an intimate and light-filled retreat

claims.text: The Grand Baglioni Maldives Villa has three bedrooms and panoramic terraces overlooking the ocean.

findings.quote: The resort’s most exclusive residence, featuring three bedrooms, generous indoor and outdoor spaces, and panoramic terraces overlooking the ocean.

claims.text: Yama serves Japanese cuisine.

findings.quote: Japanese cuisine meets ingredients from near and far culinary traditions

claims.text: Fuego is a beachside barbecue serving grilled meat and fish at sunset.

findings.quote: A beachside barbecue where you can enjoy savory grilled meat and fish specialties while admiring the sunset.

claims.text: Taste offers a daily international selection, with evenings devoted to Indian Ocean and Middle Eastern traditions.

findings.quote: Each day presents a diverse international selection, with evenings devoted to the rich traditions of the Indian Ocean and the Middle East.

claims.text: A Pizza Boat serves freshly baked pizza by the pool or seaside from a specially crafted oven.

findings.quote: Savor a freshly baked pizza by the pool or seaside, prepared in our specially crafted oven

claims.text: A children's diving experience with a certified instructor goes to a maximum depth of 2 meters.

findings.quote: Accompanied by a certified instructor, young guests can have their first encounter with marine life and learn the fundamentals of diving, up to a maximum depth of 2 meters.

claims.text: Boat excursions include dolphin watching.

findings.quote: **Dolphin Watching Tour**

claims.text: The resort has the Baglioni Aura Spa.

findings.quote: **Baglioni Aura Spa**

claims.text: The resort holds Green Globe Certification.

findings.quote: Learn more about our actions and our Green Globe Certification (GGC).

claims.text: Water Villas sit on stilts over the resort lagoon, linked to the island by a raised wooden walkway.

findings.quote: villas on stilts over the resort lagoon, linked to the island by a raised wooden walkway. Our Water Villas are ideal for gazing out at the crystalline ocean waters.

claims.text: La Limonaia serves Southern Italy-inspired fine dining in an oceanfront setting.

findings.quote: Experience Southern Italy-inspired fine dining, where tradition and modern artistry blend seamlessly in a stunning oceanfront Maldivian setting.

claims.text: The resort offers a whale shark snorkeling excursion in the Dhaalu Atoll.

findings.quote: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of the Maldives, in the heart of the Dhaalu Atoll, and swim alongside the whale shark—the gentle giant of the ocean. A snorkeling experience you’ll cherish forever.

claims.text: In-villa dining is available from 6:00 am to midnight, with meals included in the all-inclusive plan.

findings.quote: From 6:00 am to Midnight, you can enjoy our rich menu offerings every day from the comfort of your Villa, with all meals included in your all-inclusive plan.

claims.text: The Two Bedroom Family Beach Villa With Pool has two bedrooms, direct beach access and a private pool, designed for families.

findings.quote: With two bedrooms, direct beach access and a private pool, it is designed to welcome families in a relaxed and private setting.

claims.text: Guests reach the resort by a 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport.

findings.quote: The most incredible part of your journey will be the 45-minute seaplane flight from Velana International Airport

claims.text: International flights and transfers are not included; guests book flights to Velana International Airport on Male Island.

findings.quote: you’ll need to book your flights to Velana International Airport, located on Malé Island (flights & transportation are not included).

claims.text: Floating breakfast is not included in the all-inclusive plan.

findings.quote: (Floating breakfast is not included in the All-Inclusive plan.)
